_comment: A SHAPE, not a robot. Every dimension here is a 1 and every citation is TODO(source),
following the placeholder discipline OpenBuildCore used for the K2 Plus envelope (its ADR-0005):
a placeholder blocks until a real source turns up, rather than letting a number recalled from
memory look like a measurement. Copy this, replace every 1 and every TODO(source), and delete
this comment. If you leave a placeholder in, downstream answers are supposed to fail loudly.

links.note: A part_id is stored, never resolved here. Whoever needs its mass reads OpenPartsCore (ADR-0006).
The strongest of the three link kinds: an OpenDesignCore artifact whose bbox and volume are facts rather than intent.

joints.note: limits: null is UNKNOWN, never unlimited. A reachability computation over this model answers 'incomplete' and names this joint (ADR-0003) rather than assuming full travel and claiming points the mechanism cannot reach.

note: A vendor's published reach figure would go here, as prose, if it were worth recording at all.
